stock_batches_source_link.name: stock_batches_source_link
stock_batches_source_link.value: ("stock_batches"."source_type" = 'seed' AND "stock_batches"."source_id" IS NULL) OR ("stock_batches"."source_type" IN ('po', 'wh', 'stocktake') AND "stock_batches"."source_id" IS NOT NULL)

wh_docs_status.name: wh_docs_status
wh_docs_status.value: ("wh_docs"."kind" = 'in' AND "wh_docs"."status" IN ('stocked_in','voided')) OR ("wh_docs"."kind" = 'out' AND "wh_docs"."status" IN ('stocked_out','voided')) OR ("wh_docs"."kind" = 'loss' AND "wh_docs"."status" IN ('lost','voided'))

orders_ship_date_set.name: orders_ship_date_set
orders_ship_date_set.value: "orders"."status"::text NOT IN ('to_ship', 'shipped', 'voided') OR "orders"."ship_date" IS NOT NULL

orders_void_reason.name: orders_void_reason
orders_void_reason.value: "orders"."status"::text <> 'voided' OR ("orders"."shipped_at" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL)

refunds_void_reason.name: refunds_void_reason
refunds_void_reason.value: "refunds"."status" <> 'voided' OR ("refunds"."void_reason" <> '' AND "refunds"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "refunds"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL)

purchase_orders_void_reason.name: purchase_orders_void_reason
purchase_orders_void_reason.value: "purchase_orders"."status"::text <> 'voided' OR ("purchase_orders"."received_at" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_orders"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL)

purchase_orders_received_at.name: purchase_orders_received_at
purchase_orders_received_at.value: "purchase_orders"."status" NOT IN ('received', 'rejected') OR "purchase_orders"."received_at" IS NOT NULL
